name: My Dear Arenaga Oji-san
original_name: My Dear アレながおじさん
source:
Five girls have been receiving allowance by a mysterious uncle. Now as they have grown up they are summoned to the mysterious uncle's mansion to help him recover from an old snake bite.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
